verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has a REST API that can create notarization, incorporation, translation, tax- and trade-registration requests, and you can poll status and download results. It also offers HMAC-signed webhooks for real-time events, so the core workflows can be driven headlessly from scripts or pipelines. However, there is no CLI, no SDK and no CI-specific guidance, no OpenAPI spec was found (all probes 404), webhook registration happens in the dashboard, and the processes include human steps (eID/video identity checks, notary appointments). missing for 10: CLI or SDK, published OpenAPI spec, CI/headless usage docs, programmatic webhook and credential setup, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end unattended automation.
